select
coalesce(m.id, 0) as groupId, coalesce(m.merchant_name, '（未填对方）') as groupName,
item.id as groupId, item.item_name as groupName,
sku.id as groupId, concat(coalesce(item.item_name, ''), ' ', coalesce(sku.sku_name, '')) as groupName,
cat.id as groupId, coalesce(cat.category_name, '（未分类）') as groupName,
date_format(o.biz_date, '%Y-%m') as groupId, date_format(o.biz_date, '%Y-%m') as groupName,
o.biz_date as groupId, date_format(o.biz_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as groupName,
'全部' as groupId, '全部' as groupName,
count(distinct o.id) as orderCount, count(d.id) as lineCount, coalesce(sum(d.quantity), 0) as quantity, coalesce(sum(coalesce(d.amount, d.quantity * coalesce( sku.selling_pricesku.cost_price, 0))), 0) as amount, coalesce(sum(d.quantity * coalesce(sku.cost_price, 0)), 0) as costAmount from wms_shipment_order_detailwms_receipt_order_detail d inner join wms_shipment_orderwms_receipt_order o on d.order_id = o.id left join wms_item_sku sku on d.sku_id = sku.id left join wms_item item on sku.item_id = item.id left join wms_item_category cat on item.item_category = cat.id left join wms_merchant m on o.merchant_id = m.id
o.order_status = 1
and o.biz_date between #{begin} and #{end}
and o.merchant_id in #{id}
and d.sku_id in #{id}
group by groupId, groupName
order by
quantity desc groupId asc amount desc
limit #{limit}
